title: Proposal Mode Governance Rules
description: JSON Schema for governance rules applied to macp.mode.proposal.v1 sessions. See RFC-MACP-0012 Section 4.3.

criterion.description: Who must accept for a proposal to be considered accepted.

max_rounds.$comment: The bound is inclusive on purpose and MUST NOT be tightened to exclusiveMinimum. 0 is the documented default and means unlimited -- a disable sentinel, not a trivially-satisfied bar -- so rejecting it would reject this field's own default. Audited under issue #116 piece 2; the analogy with the quorum threshold floor of issue #110 does not hold, because that value is a bar and this one is a sentinel.

terminal_on_any_reject.description: If true, any rejection terminates the session.

allOf.$comment: Ported verbatim from decision-rules.schema.json, which has enforced this since it was written. `authority: "designated_role"` with no `designated_roles` declares that only designated roles may commit and then names none -- an unsatisfiable authority rule that either bricks the session or fails open depending on the runtime (issue #116). minItems 1 is part of the constraint: an empty array names no one either.
